name: Dots Compress
description: Three dots that compress from horizontal line to vertical stack

variations.name: default
variations.description: Three dots alternating between horizontal spread and vertical stack with container morphing

props.name: width
props.description: Initial width of the loader in horizontal state (pixels)

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Diameter of each dot in pixels

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
